about: ShoeMart is an online shoe ecommerce store based in Mumbai, India. We offer a wide range of premium footwear including casual sneakers, running shoes, and sports shoes from top brands like Nike, Adidas, Sparx, and Jordan.
hours: We are open Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We remain closed on Sundays.
policyReturn: We offer a 20-day easy return policy. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
policyShipping: We offer free shipping on orders above ₹500. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery is available for an additional ₹150 and takes 1-2 business days.
policyWarranty: All our products come with a 6-month manufacturer warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover wear and tear from normal use.

faqs.question: Do you offer exchange?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer size exchange within 20 days of delivery. The product must be in original condition with tags.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and Cash on Delivery.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via email and SMS. You can also track your order from the 'Track Order' section on our website.
